recommendation: Keep the source change because it aligns the active terminology-service page with FHIR-14539, the existing CodeSystem/TerminologyCapabilities resource pages, and later final FHIR-24698 requirements. Treat broader extension-pack deprecation as separate FHIR-53787 work if approved.
issue_request: FHIR-14539 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and requested clarification that a CodeSystem resource on a server declares code-system properties, not terminology-service support or expected server behavior; those server-specific capabilities belong in TerminologyCapabilities.
initial_application: Git-svn commit 5f643f386b330d8acbf2ca54005bd1629e74c3d1 (svn revision 14023) added the CodeSystem/TerminologyCapabilities distinction to CodeSystem and TerminologyCapabilities introductions. The companion FHIR-17106 commit 8df77e615ed345d437f53121de0b1ffbb579663e documented GET [base]/metadata?mode=terminology.
additional_context: The current CodeSystem and TerminologyCapabilities pages retained the intended distinction, and FHIR-24698 later made terminology-service conformance requirements explicit by requiring mode=terminology to return TerminologyCapabilities.codeSystem entries for supported systems. The terminology-service page is active via source/terminology-module.html and source/hierarchy.xml. FHIR-53787 is an unresolved external-pack proposal to deprecate the old CapabilityStatement supported-system extension and was not decided here.
reconciliation: Changed source/terminology-service.html to state that additional external code systems supported by a terminology server are published in the server's TerminologyCapabilities statement returned by the capabilities interaction with mode=terminology, and removed the stale CapabilityStatement supported-system JSON example from core narrative.
source_changes: source/terminology-service.html: replaced CapabilityStatement supported-system extension guidance for additional external code-system support with TerminologyCapabilities mode=terminology guidance.

related_jiras.note: Defined the TerminologyCapabilities access method that FHIR-14539 expected for server-specific terminology capabilities.
Published later terminology-service conformance requirements requiring TerminologyCapabilities.codeSystem entries for supported code systems.
Unresolved FHIR Extension Pack proposal to deprecate the old CapabilityStatement supported-system extension; not decided in this core-source reconciliation.
